ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with low-intensity (black) pixels occupying approximately 85% of the visible surface area and high-intensity (white) pixels occupying approximately 15% concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous black region extending from the median notch to the leading edges. High-intensity white contiguous blobs are located at the lateral extremities of both lobes, featuring internal vertical low-intensity striations and 'feathered' edges where white meets black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth from the lobe peaks of approximately 60 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary; left lobe contains 9-10 distinct peaks and the right lobe contains 11-12 distinct peaks with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels deep.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory extending from the median notch vertex toward the acute, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized circular clusters of black pixels (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are detected within the high-intensity white patches on both the left and right distal lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal thin black linear disruptions (rake marks) are detected cutting across the white pigmentation on the lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of parallel linear rake marks and localized dark circular scarring on the high-contrast white areas of the distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The internal boundary of the white patches exhibits a unique 'brush-stroke' or feathered gradient pattern transitioning into the solid black central region.
